title: Reading Between the Lines: Deconfounding Causal Estimates using Text Embeddings and Deep Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the deviation of estimated causal treatment effects (Average Treatment Effect) from a known ground truth in a synthetic dataset to quantify statistical bias caused by unobserved confounders.

Using a Monte Carlo simulation with synthetic freelancer data to measure how different machine learning architectures (tree-based vs. neural networks) within a Double Machine Learning framework reduce the estimation bias stemming from omitted latent variables (ability and motivation).
